message.content:
Sure thing! I’ll give you a quick step‑by‑step guide so you can set up a reminder yourself (since I don’t have direct access to your personal calendars). Pick whichever method works best for you:

---

### 📅 Option 1 – **Google Calendar**  
*(works on desktop & mobile)*  

| Step | Action |
|------|--------|
| 1️⃣ | Go to <https://calendar.google.com> (or open the Google Calendar app) |
| 2️⃣ | Click “Create” (+ button) at top left / tap “+” on mobile |
| 3️⃣ | Title: `Netflix Subscription Renewal` |
| 4️⃣ | Date: **March 27, 2024** |
| 5️⃣ | Time: Set whatever time suits you (e.g., 9 AM) |
| 6️⃣ | Under “Add notification”, choose *“Email”* or *“Pop-up”* 30–60 minutes before |
| 7️⃣ | Save |

Your phone will buzz/email when it's time!

---

### 🗓️ Option 2 – **Apple Reminders** *(iOS/macOS only)*  

| Step | Action |
|------|--------|
| 1️⃣ | Open the **Reminders** app |
| 2️⃣ | Tap “New Reminder” |
| 3️⃣ | Text: `Renew Netflix subscription` |
| 4️⃣ | Tap the info icon (ℹ︎), enable “On a Day” → pick **Mar 27, 2024**, then set a specific time |
| 5️⃣ | Toggle “Alert” → choose “At time of event” or custom offset |
| 6️⃣ | Done |

It will pop up right on your device’s lock screen or home screen.

---

### 🔔 Option 3 – **Microsoft Outlook / Office 365**

If you’re already using Outlook:

1. Create a new appointment on Mar 27, 2024.
2. Add subject: `Netflix renewal`.
3. Turn on an alert (“Reminder”) e.g., 15 min prior.
4. Mark as “All day” if you prefer a simple banner.

---

#### Quick Tips

- If you like voice assistants, simply tell Siri/Cortana/Google Assistant:  
  `"Set a reminder for March 27 to renew my Netflix subscription."`
- You can also write a short note in a notebook or sticky‑note app—just keep it somewhere visible until the deadline passes.

Let me know which platform you're using, and I can tailor the instructions even more precisely!
